citation: Misuse of Drugs Act 1973 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition

source.version_stated: Current version as at 01 Oct 2026; PDF created date 01 Oct 2026
source.edition: 2020 Revised Edition, which incorporates all amendments up to and including 1 December 2021 and came into operation on 31 December 2021; the text carries marginal amendments after that date, the latest being Act 9 of 2026 wef 01/05/2026 and G.N. No. S 321/2026 wef 1 June 2026
source.note: Singapore Statutes Online PDF, an unofficial consolidation (SSO Terms of Use cl.8). One vintage: the law as at 01 Oct 2026. The PDF was supplied to the encoder from the user's folder 'SG Acts'; how it was fetched (by hand or by a script) is not known. Text and PDF deposited in source/; see source/PROVENANCE.md.

scope_note: The encoding covers the offences (Parts 2, 2A, 2B: ss 5 to 14 and 11A to 11Q), the definitions they turn on (s 2) and the proof of a psychoactive substance (ss 22A, 22B), the evidence rules and presumptions (ss 15 to 23), the powers of search, arrest, specimen and forfeiture (ss 24 to 28, 30 to 32), jurisdiction (s 53), and every punishment: the Second Schedule's printed table in full (86 rows) with ss 33, 33A, 33B, and the punishments the other sections state. NOT encoded: the lists of substances in the First and Third Schedules (the class of a drug is an input), treatment and rehabilitation (ss 34 to 40), photographs and body samples (ss 40A to 40D), committees of inquiry (ss 41 to 52), regulations (s 58); see encodings/NOTES.md.

related_subjects.criminal-procedure-code-2010: sg/criminal-procedure-code-2010: the interface module written-law-interface.l4 is carried identically in this row, the Code's row and the Prevention of Corruption Act row; the Code reads the Act's statement about its own offences (s 25(1) police power of arrest, s 53 District Court) in cpc-other-laws.l4. The Act is item 12 of the Code's Second Schedule.
related_subjects.penal-code-1871: sg/penal-code-1871: s 42(4) and s 57(4) deem committee members and auxiliary police officers public servants within the Code's meaning; ss 12 to 14 sit beside the Code's chapters on abetment, attempt and conspiracy
related_subjects.evidence-act-1893: sg/evidence-act-1893: the presumptions (ss 17 to 22) and certificates (ss 15, 16, 31(6), 33(4AC) to (4AE), 33A(3), (4)) are the Act's own rules of proof beside the Evidence Act's presumptions (ss 4, 81 to 116A) and ss 126 and 127 (informers); 'proved' is the Evidence Act s 3's word
related_subjects.prevention-of-corruption-act-1960: sg/prevention-of-corruption-act-1960: the other Act that creates its own offences and procedure and makes a statement to the Code
